Vol'jin cremation ceremony outside of Orgrimmar.]] Funerals are ceremonies performed to honor the remains of a deceased. On Azeroth and beyond, each race has its own funeral rites according to their culture and beliefs, whether by burials, cremations, mummifications, or other processes. Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm (formerly known as Furlbrow's Pumpkin Patch) was one of the many farms in Westfall taken over by the Defias Brotherhood and their mechanical harvest golems. The killing machines used to patrol the fields before the Cataclysm, with the Defias taking up residence in the farm buildings. Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna fled during that time to the road near the Jansen Stead in northern Westfall. After the Cataclysm, the Furlbrows have apparently met an untimely demise near the Jansen Stead, their deaths currently under investigation. Furlbrow's Pocket Watch belonged to Farmer Furlbrow. Fur Linings were augments that were added in Wrath of the Lich King. These were made by leatherworkers and could only be put on bracers for a stats bonus. Fur Linings were removed with the Warlords of Draenor expansion, along with all other profession-exclusive bonuses. Each type of Fur Lining required a Leatherworking skill of 400 and required 1 . The resulting bracer enchant is self-only and equivalent to other enchants provided by other tradeskills. It also provides more stats than any enchant players can currently acquire.

Gahrron's Withering is an abandoned farmstead located at the eastern end of the Western Plaguelands. Formerly known as Gahrron's Quickening, the farm has been taken over by the Scourge. They have placed a large cauldron in the middle of the field which constantly spews disease-filled vapors into the air. The cauldron is guarded by Cauldron Lord Soulwrath and other Scourge officers. Haunting Visions and many Wailing Deaths and Hungering Wraiths. Gahrron's Withering is a popular place for grinding Argent Dawn reputation, as the quest involving the Scourge Cauldron located here provides the best reputation of the four Cauldron quests. GTG is an acronym for "Good to Go" or "Got to Go", typically used to indicate urgency when recruiting for a group. A project taken on by WOW players initially on 11/24/2007 as a bet to each other. __NOTOC__ Gaeriyan is a human ghost roaming the cliffs northeast of Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He can only be seen while the player is dead. Donova Snowden sent adventurers to seek him out (equipped with a Videre Elixir, a convenient means of attaining ghost form so they could speak to him) so that he could tell them how to finish improving Linken's sword, more specifically by revealing the secret hidden under A Conspicuous Gravestone in the Gadgetzan graveyard.

GKP (Gold Kill Points?) is a way for groups (Usually PUGs) to decide who gets loot that drops in an instance. Rather than using DKP, when an item drops, players bid gold for the item, and the person who bids the most wins. At the end of the entire raid (Or each boss, as some GKP leaders tend to do) the gold is then split among all the players attending the GKP run. GKP runs can often have the same problems that PUGs have, such as incompetent players. They can also suffer from a dishonest raid leader who doesn't split the gold at the end of the run, and instead keeps it for themself.

The Fury Visor is a quest reward from Voodoo Feathers which starts with the Fallen Hero of the Horde in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Fury of the Ursine were epic cloth wrist armor for DPS casters.

__NOTOC__ Gahju is a jungle troll quest giver located at the Sunreaver Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He was present during Death Rising.
Th Futuresight Rune is a quest reward from Mystery of the Infinite, Redux.
Gadgetzan Snipers are goblin guards at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

The Gadgetzan Water Company (or Gadgetzan Water Co.) are a subgroup of the Gadgetzan goblins and responsible for building wells across the desert to farm fresh water. Members could originally be found in Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port. The Water Co. Security is their security service. Since the Cataclysm, most of the members disappeared with only Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle located in Zul'Farrak.

Fuselight is a new town in the Lethlor Ravine of the Badlands. It is run by the Steamwheedle Cartel goblins, and unlike most of the smaller towns the few quests there will award reputation with them. It contains a goblin laboratory. Gek Nozzlerocket is a Fuselight recruiter in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Fuselight-by-the-Sea is a picturesque seaside town founded by explosives enthusiasts for explosives enthusiasts. This new Steamwheedle Cartel port town in the Badlands is connected via transporter to its sister town, also in the Badlands, Fuselight. Questing players get sent here from Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands by way of rocket in one of the central breadcrumb quests (Hero's Call: Badlands! / Warchief's Command: Badlands!)
This quest chain explains (in part, at least) why the Kvaldir are attacking in Northrend, and what the Kalu'ak are trying to do to placate them.
Gahrron's Shoulderguard is a quest reward from Memories from a Lost Past.

Fury of Stormrage is a third tier restoration druid talent that greatly enhances both Wrath and Starfire. This talent was initially designed to bring in some free damage for the player, while it does have its potential it is often skipped for those who are solely healing.
Gahrron Prayer Book is looted from the Prayer Book in the Western Plaguelands.
Gahz'rilla Spawns are the children of Kai'ju Gahz'rilla, they can be found in the pool in Zul'Farrak.
